department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

deadline.value: Apply by December 15 (2026) for Fall 2027; this is also the fellowship deadline.
deadline.quote: Fall Deadline December 15 | To be considered for fellowships, all application materials are due by the fall deadline.

gre_subject.value: No subject GRE policy stated; this field has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: No advisor is needed to apply, but research assistantships depend on matching a professor, so contacting faculty is encouraged; you need an advisor by the end of year one.
supervisor.quote: Students interested in research assistantships in a particular area are encouraged to contact professors whose work is of special interest. | Students without an advisor at the end of their first year enrolled are in danger of failing to make adequate progress towards their degree.

funding.value: RAs, a limited number of TAs and competitive fellowships are awarded based on your application and faculty match; funding is not stated as guaranteed.
funding.quote: Decisions regarding financial support are made on the basis of your graduate school application, and, for research assistantships, the matching of the interests or experience of the applicant to the research programs of individual faculty members.

entry_route.value: Apply with a BS in physical sciences or engineering (GPA 3.0 minimum; most admits are above 3.5).
entry_route.quote: Applicants normally are expected to have a BS in the physical sciences or engineering.

notes: Department site (engineering.wisc.edu) blocked; data from the Graduate Guide.
